description: Fork of exp536 (soft-anchor-pair, fast anneal). FIX: anneal tau all the way toward ~0 instead of holding at 0.02. exp536 held tau=0.02 for the back half -> anchors ~97% hard, but the residual 3% blend flips sign bits for boundary tokens, and because a row needs ALL NAP bits to match (row-match = (1-eps)^NAP), ~17% of lookups hit a different (uncorrelated) row in the HARD eval -> a persistent +0.11 soft<->hard gap that never refines away. exp536 soft reached ~+0.020 vs exp530 (near-tie) but hard stuck +0.11. Fix = TWO-PHASE tau anneal: phase1 1.0->0.02 over first 30% (fast, sharpen bits during peak LR, same as exp536 -> soft learns good pairs), phase2 0.02->1e-3 over the remaining 70% (drive tau toward 0 so the soft-trained model BECOMES the exact hard model -> residual -> 0, deliverable hard == soft). Anchors are effectively frozen (committed) by ~step 2400; phase2 mainly hardens the blends to one-hot while weights refine. Everything else identical to exp536. Watch: does soft<->hard gap collapse toward 0 by the end, and where does the (now=hard) model land vs exp530 1.4731? vs exp536 (held 0.02: soft +0.02 / hard +0.11), exp530 1.4731.
